profile_paragraphs: Universidad de Los Lagos is a Chilean state higher-education institution created by Law 19.238 on 30 August 1993.
Its Medicina degree started in Osorno in 2026, with 35 first-year places. It is a new programme, not an established medical faculty with graduating cohorts.
Medicine sits within the Departamento de Salud, founded in 2012. The department also runs health programmes including nursing, physiotherapy, pharmacy, occupational therapy and medical technology.

ULagos, Universidad de La Frontera and Hospital Base San José de Osorno signed a January 2026 memorandum connected to the launch of Medicina. The hospital’s public procurement lists adult rheumatology consultations.

For a rheumatologist, the relevant opportunity is an early-stage programme linked to a hospital that provides adult rheumatology. ULagos has not published a rheumatology specialty programme; even its family-medicine specialty was still being evaluated in April 2026.
